annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2024/1860 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024 amending Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746 as regards a gradual roll-out of Eudamed, the obligation to inform in case of interruption or discontinuation of supply, and transitional provisions for certain in vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2024/1860 amending Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746 as regards a gradual roll-out of Eudamed, the obligation to inform in case of interruption or discontinuation of supply, and transitional provisions for certain in vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Regulation amending the Medical Device Regulation and In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation to allow gradual roll-out of the Eudamed database, require advance notice of supply interruptions, and extend transitional periods for in vitro diagnostic devices. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Introduces Article 10a: manufacturers must give 6 months' notice of anticipated supply interruption likely to cause serious harm
Allows gradual roll-out of individual Eudamed electronic systems, applying 6 months after notice of functionality
Extends IVDR transitional periods to 2027-2029 by device class, subject to conditions
Sets deadlines for quality management systems, notified body applications and written agreements
Enters into force on publication; Article 10a applies from 10 January 2025
